children: Namibia’s annual inflation rate climbed to 5% in August 2026, the highest since February 2024, accelerating from 4.4% in each of the previous two months.
The pickup was driven mainly by a sharp increase in transportation costs, with inflation in the category jumping to 13.2% from 9.3% in July.
Significant price pressures also came from hotels, cafés and restaurants (6.2% vs 6.2%); health (5% vs 4.8%); food & non-alcoholic beverages (4% vs 3.7%) and housing & utlities (4.3% vs 4.8%).
On a monthly basis, the CPI rose by 0.6%, after a 0.1% increase in the prior month.

title: Namibia Inflation Rate Quickens 2-1/2-Year High of 5%
